The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of the changes made for PR A:

## Certificate detection & issuance refinement

**New `checkcert()` helper (vps.sh:174)** — recognizes and reuses existing certificates from either location:
- `/etc/trojan/trojan.crt` + `/etc/trojan/trojan.key` (legacy/accepted location)
- `~/.acme.sh/${domain}_ecc/fullchain.cer` + `~/.acme.sh/${domain}_ecc/${domain}.key` (ACME storage)
- When none exist, `crt_path`/`key_path` default to the ACME storage location so newly issued certs are referenced directly from there.

**`issuecert()` (vps.sh:335)** — now uses `checkcert()` (fixes the previous `-n /etc/trojan/trojan.crt` string test that was always true), and for newly issued certs references the ACME storage directly (replacing the old `--installcert` copy to `/etc/trojan/`).

**API-issuance block in `userinput()` (vps.sh:663-759)** — same detection replaced, user-placed certs in `/etc/trojan` are still moved to canonical names (glob bug fixed with for-loops), new API-issued certs reference ACME storage directly. No `--defaultno` was re-added.

**Config templates** — tmCrypt client, dnscrypt-proxy.toml, and nginx trojan.conf now use `${crt_path}`/`${key_path}`, so services point at the ACME storage location used during issuance. Matching conf/ reference files were updated to stay coherent.

**Domain verification (vps.sh:1023)** now uses `checkcert()` so reuse of ACME-stored certs also skips re-verification.

**New `systemrequirecheck()` (vps.sh:191)** — checks total RAM from `/proc/meminfo` (no new external commands); if below 512 MB it shows a bilingual warning and an `Insufficient RAM` whiptail prompt to continue or abort.
